historicalReplay.rule: Intermediate visible construction height is interpolated only between recorded administrative or construction-year milestones and is always labeled modeled.

priceModel.target: annual nominal median recorded sale price for the selected 2020 NTA and tax class
priceModel.equation: nextPrice = priorPrice * (1 + clamp(momentum + demand + financing + constructionCost + policy - supply + seededShock, -0.15, 0.18))
priceModel.validation: Forecast skill is reported only when the complete published price-and-development pipeline can be reconstructed over historical holdout years. The current governed snapshot lacks historical parcel-capacity, financing, and construction-cost states, so validation fails closed and reports no MAPE or interval coverage.
priceModel.selectionBias: Annual medians are composition-sensitive and are not a repeat-sales index.

developmentModel.candidateBasis: Current PLUTO lots within the selected NTA are evaluated without a compiler-imposed per-region cap and ranked by tax-class-compatible mapped FAR capacity.
developmentModel.equation: startScore = capacity + demand + zoning policy + seeded capital availability - financing cost - construction cost
developmentModel.completionRule: Selected projects complete after a modeled duration based on tax-class-compatible units or commercial floor area.

sectorRules.tax-class-1: One-to-three-family residential; modeled units are capped at three per lot and affordable-unit policy is inapplicable.
sectorRules.tax-class-2: Multifamily residential; potential units use 900 residential square feet per unit before policy and feasibility discounts.
sectorRules.tax-class-4: Commercial and industrial; output is commercial floor area, residential units are zero, and affordable-unit policy is inapplicable.
sectorRules.all: Price aggregation only; mixed-sector development generation is refused.

developmentModel.affordabilityRule: Affordable units are a scenario share only for tax-class-2 modeled completed units, not observed commitments.
developmentModel.randomnessRule: Baseline and intervention use the exact same seed-derived site, annual shock, capital-cycle, and duration draws; policy identifiers never alter the exogenous stream.
developmentModel.conservation: Every future candidate is unstarted, active, completed, or excluded once per ensemble member; completed units and floor area cannot exceed modeled effective capacity.

value.interpretation: Seeded scenario ensemble conditional on declared controls and governed inputs; percentiles are not calibrated probabilities of individual property value.

claimBoundary: This model explores conditional neighborhood scenarios. It does not appraise a parcel, forecast rent or mortgage performance, prove causal policy effects, predict a specific permit, or replace professional planning, valuation, engineering, environmental, legal, or investment analysis.
